body: The seed bag is kept beside a water bottle; the notebook page where the plot directions should be has been removed.
title: Plot with no note

body: Orchard diary: at the apple mark, windfalls carried a waxy film after the trial pass. The buyer rejected them before any evacuation notice.
title: Apple mark beside treated windfalls

body: Repair receipt: the hammer mark identifies the pump sealed after drawing cloudy field water. Its gasket was new, yet the metal inside had turned green.
title: Hammer mark for a sealed pump

body: Cash slip at the fuel symbol: twelve gallons for the trial sprayer, though its tank holds eight. The clerk wrote the excess under a second farm number.
title: Fuel symbol on the sprayer account

body: Photograph back at the apple symbol: the rejected fruit crate has clean skins on top and spotted fruit underneath. A field-trial ribbon is tied to one handle.
title: Apple symbol and the rejected crate

body: Repair note at the hammer symbol: replace the pump gasket after the experimental feed runoff. The old rubber had turned green without cracking.
title: Hammer symbol over a green gasket
